clips.send: The sign rules for multiplication: same signs give a positive product, different signs give a negative product. Only the signs decide the sign; the sizes simply multiply.
clips.text: The sign rules for multiplication: same signs give a positive product, different signs give a negative product. Only the signs decide the sign; the sizes simply multiply.

clips.send: Put it together: (negative2) times 3 minus (negative5) . Multiply first: three jumps of negative2 reach negative6 . Then subtracting negative5 means adding 5: walk right 5 to land on negative1 .
clips.text: Put it together: (-2) times 3 - (-5). Multiply first: three jumps of -2 reach -6. Then subtracting -5 means adding 5: walk right 5 to land on -1.

clips.send: Another way to see it: multiplying by negative1 flips a number to the other side of zero. Flip 3 once: negative3 . Flip again: back to 3. So (negative2) times (negative3) means stretch negative3 to negative6 , then flip: plus 6 .
clips.text: Another way to see it: multiplying by -1 flips a number to the other side of zero. Flip 3 once: -3. Flip again: back to 3. So (-2) times (-3) means stretch -3 to -6, then flip: +6.

clips.send: Adding means moving along the number line. 3 plus 4 : start at 3 and step 4 to the right, landing on 7. Adding a negative steps LEFT: 3 plus (negative5) lands on negative2 .
clips.text: Adding means moving along the number line. 3 + 4: start at 3 and step 4 to the right, landing on 7. Adding a negative steps LEFT: 3 + (-5) lands on -2.

clips.send: But what is (negative1) times (negative2) ? “Negative one group” makes no sense, so follow the pattern. Each time the first factor goes down by 1, the answer goes UP by 2. Keep going past zero: 2, 4, 6. So a negative times a negative is positive!
clips.text: But what is (-1) times (-2)? “Negative one group” makes no sense, so follow the pattern. Each time the first factor goes down by 1, the answer goes UP by 2. Keep going past zero: 2, 4, 6. So a negative times a negative is positive!

clips.send: Division undoes multiplication, so it follows the same rules. Since (negative2) times (negative3) equals 6 , we get 6 divided by (negative2) equals negative3 . Since (negative2) times 3 equals negative6 , we get negative6 divided by (negative2) equals 3 . Same signs: positive; different signs: negative.
clips.text: Division undoes multiplication, so it follows the same rules. Since (-2) times (-3) = 6, we get 6 div (-2) = -3. Since (-2) times 3 = -6, we get -6 div (-2) = 3. Same signs: positive; different signs: negative.

clips.send: Same trick for 3 minus (negative2) : add 2 zero pairs, then take away 2 red chips: 5 yellow remain. Taking away negative2 gives the same result as adding plus 2 . Subtracting is adding the opposite: a minus b equals a plus (negativeb) .
clips.text: Same trick for 3 - (-2): add 2 zero pairs, then take away 2 red chips: 5 yellow remain. Taking away -2 gives the same result as adding +2. Subtracting is adding the opposite: a - b = a + (-b).

clips.send: Another picture: chips. A yellow chip is plus 1 , a red chip is negative1 , and one of each makes a zero pair: ( plus 1) plus (negative1) equals 0 . In 5 plus (negative3) , three zero pairs vanish and 2 yellow chips remain, so the answer is 2.
clips.text: Another picture: chips. A yellow chip is +1, a red chip is -1, and one of each makes a zero pair: (+1) + (-1) = 0. In 5 + (-3), three zero pairs vanish and 2 yellow chips remain, so the answer is 2.

clips.send: Subtraction means take away. 5 minus 2 : remove 2 yellow chips and 3 are left. But 2 minus 5 ? There are only 2 to take! Add 3 zero pairs (that adds 0, so the value is still 2), then take away 5 yellow chips: 3 red remain, so 2 minus 5 equals negative3 .
clips.text: Subtraction means take away. 5 - 2: remove 2 yellow chips and 3 are left. But 2 - 5? There are only 2 to take! Add 3 zero pairs (that adds 0, so the value is still 2), then take away 5 yellow chips: 3 red remain, so 2 - 5 = -3.

clips.send: Multiplication counts equal groups. 3 times 2 is 3 groups of 2 yellow chips: 6. 3 times (negative2) is 3 groups of 2 red chips: negative6 . A positive times a negative is negative.
clips.text: Multiplication counts equal groups. 3 times 2 is 3 groups of 2 yellow chips: 6. 3 times (-2) is 3 groups of 2 red chips: -6. A positive times a negative is negative.

clips.send: 综合练习： (负2) 乘 3 减 (负5) 。先算乘法：跳三次 负2 ，到达 负6 。再减去 负5 ，也就是加上 5：向右走 5 格，停在 负1 。
clips.text: 综合练习：(-2) times 3 - (-5)。先算乘法：跳三次 -2，到达 -6。再减去 -5，也就是加上 5：向右走 5 格，停在 -1。

clips.send: 3 减 (负2) 也一样：先放进 2 对零对，再拿走 2 个红片，剩下 5 个黄片。拿走 负2 和加上 加 2 结果相同。减去一个数，等于加上它的相反数： a 减 b 等于 a 加 (负b) 。
clips.text: 3 - (-2) 也一样：先放进 2 对零对，再拿走 2 个红片，剩下 5 个黄片。拿走 -2 和加上 +2 结果相同。减去一个数，等于加上它的相反数：a - b = a + (-b)。

clips.send: 乘法的符号法则：同号得正，异号得负。积的符号只由因数的符号决定，绝对值照常相乘。
clips.text: 乘法的符号法则：同号得正，异号得负。积的符号只由因数的符号决定，绝对值照常相乘。

clips.send: 乘法表示几个相同的组。 3 乘 2 是 3 组、每组 2 个黄片：6。 3 乘 (负2) 是 3 组、每组 2 个红片： 负6 。正数乘负数得负数。
clips.text: 乘法表示几个相同的组。3 times 2 是 3 组、每组 2 个黄片：6。3 times (-2) 是 3 组、每组 2 个红片：-6。正数乘负数得负数。

clips.send: 除法是乘法的逆运算，所以符号法则相同。因为 (负2) 乘 (负3) 等于 6 ，所以 6 除以 (负2) 等于 负3 ；因为 (负2) 乘 3 等于 负6 ，所以 负6 除以 (负2) 等于 3 。同号得正，异号得负。
clips.text: 除法是乘法的逆运算，所以符号法则相同。因为 (-2) times (-3) = 6，所以 6 div (-2) = -3；因为 (-2) times 3 = -6，所以 -6 div (-2) = 3。同号得正，异号得负。

clips.send: 加法就是在数轴上移动。 3 加 4 ：从 3 出发，向右走 4 格，停在 7。加上一个负数就向左走： 3 加 (负5) 停在 负2 。
clips.text: 加法就是在数轴上移动。3 + 4：从 3 出发，向右走 4 格，停在 7。加上一个负数就向左走：3 + (-5) 停在 -2。

clips.send: 容易混淆：“负负得正”只适用于乘法和除法！加法不是这样：（减3） + (减4) 等于减7，两个负数相加结果更负。另外减5减3 是减8，不是减2：减 3 就是再向左走 3 格。
clips.text: 容易混淆：“负负得正”只适用于乘法和除法！加法不是这样：（−3） + (−4) = −7，两个负数相加结果更负。另外 −5 − 3 是 −8，不是 −2：减 3 就是再向左走 3 格。

clips.send: 换一种模型：正负片。黄片表示 加 1 ，红片表示 负1 ，一黄一红组成“零对”： ( 加 1) 加 (负1) 等于 0 。在 5 加 (负3) 中，三对零对抵消掉，剩下 2 个黄片，所以结果是 2。
clips.text: 换一种模型：正负片。黄片表示 +1，红片表示 -1，一黄一红组成“零对”：(+1) + (-1) = 0。在 5 + (-3) 中，三对零对抵消掉，剩下 2 个黄片，所以结果是 2。

clips.send: 换个角度：乘以 负1 就是把数翻到 0 的另一侧。把 3 翻一次： 负3 ；再翻一次：回到 3。所以 (负2) 乘 (负3) 就是先把 负3 拉长成 负6 ，再翻转： 加 6 。
clips.text: 换个角度：乘以 -1 就是把数翻到 0 的另一侧。把 3 翻一次：-3；再翻一次：回到 3。所以 (-2) times (-3) 就是先把 -3 拉长成 -6，再翻转：+6。

clips.send: 减法就是“拿走”。 5 减 2 ：拿走 2 个黄片，剩下 3 个。那 2 减 5 呢？只有 2 个黄片可拿！先放进 3 对零对（加的是 0，值还是 2），再拿走 5 个黄片：剩下 3 个红片，所以 2 减 5 等于 负3 。
clips.text: 减法就是“拿走”。5 - 2：拿走 2 个黄片，剩下 3 个。那 2 - 5 呢？只有 2 个黄片可拿！先放进 3 对零对（加的是 0，值还是 2），再拿走 5 个黄片：剩下 3 个红片，所以 2 - 5 = -3。

clips.send: 可 (负1) 乘 (负2) 是多少？“负 1 组”说不通，那就顺着规律走。第一个因数每减少 1，积就增加 2。越过 0 继续往下：2、4、6。所以负数乘负数得正数！
clips.text: 可 (-1) times (-2) 是多少？“负 1 组”说不通，那就顺着规律走。第一个因数每减少 1，积就增加 2。越过 0 继续往下：2、4、6。所以负数乘负数得正数！
